comment: COT-ORG-02 — protocol-semantic negative vectors for ck.realm.organization (RealmOrganizationPayload). Every vector is consumed by tests/realm_organization_statement_negative.rs which drives the cokret-core EventPayloadValidatorCatalog::validate_payload (strong schema dispatch on `ck.realm.organization`) and the cokret_core::models::realm_governance::verify_realm_organization_statement verifier. `surface=verifier` cases MUST be rejected by verify_realm_organization_statement under the declared resolver, and the verifier error embeds the pinned spec wire reason-code (error-code-registry / reason-code-registry) — the test asserts that exact code token, never a project-private string. `surface=schema` cases MUST be rejected by the strong payload JSON-schema; that validator echoes the schema $id, not the registry token, so for schema cases the test asserts rejection and expected.reason_code stays documentary (it classifies the wire failure as schema_violation). A declared-but-unverified organization (only owning_organizations, no active statement) is NOT modelled here because there is no statement to validate — that gap is covered by the organization-policy e2e (case A).

negative_vectors.name: active_missing_proof
negative_vectors.comment: Active statement whose authorization.proof is blank must fail closed; an unproven statement cannot endorse the relationship.

negative_vectors.name: active_missing_proof_field_schema
negative_vectors.comment: Strong payload schema requires authorization.proof; removing it is a schema_violation independent of the verifier.

negative_vectors.name: governance_service_missing_delegation_ref
negative_vectors.comment: issuer_role=governance_service is a delegated role; the statement MUST carry a delegation_ref. Absent ⇒ schema_violation.

negative_vectors.name: account_authority_missing_delegation_ref
negative_vectors.comment: issuer_role=account_authority is a delegated role; missing delegation_ref ⇒ schema_violation.

negative_vectors.name: governance_service_missing_delegation_ref_schema
negative_vectors.comment: Strong payload schema allOf requires delegation_ref when issuer_role is governance_service/account_authority.

negative_vectors.name: non_delegated_role_with_delegation_ref
negative_vectors.comment: organization_did is NOT a delegated role; carrying a delegation_ref is invalid coupling ⇒ schema_violation.

negative_vectors.name: delegated_role_unresolvable_delegation_fails_closed
negative_vectors.comment: governance_service with a delegation_ref that does not resolve fails closed; upstream grant is treated as revoked/absent.

negative_vectors.name: delegated_role_not_live_delegation
negative_vectors.comment: Delegation resolves but is_live=false (expired/revoked upstream) ⇒ grant_revoked_upstream.

negative_vectors.name: delegation_scope_not_covering_official_badge
negative_vectors.comment: Statement requests official_badge + realm_admin but the delegation only covers realm_admin. The uncovered scope cannot be endorsed ⇒ grant_exceeds_issuer_authority. This is the scope-coverage gate for official badge / governance policy.

negative_vectors.name: delegation_relationship_not_covered
negative_vectors.comment: Statement asserts relationship=governance but the delegation only covers owner ⇒ grant_exceeds_issuer_authority (cannot grant a governance-policy relationship outside the delegation purpose).

negative_vectors.name: expired_statement
negative_vectors.comment: expires_at <= now ⇒ the statement is no longer in effect (ttl_expired). An expired endorsement does not grant official badge or governance policy.

negative_vectors.name: not_yet_valid_statement
negative_vectors.comment: not_before > now ⇒ the statement is not yet in its validity window (failed_precondition).

negative_vectors.name: realm_id_mismatch
negative_vectors.comment: payload.realm_id must equal the enclosing Event.realm_id; a statement bound to another Realm cannot endorse this one.

negative_vectors.name: revoked_without_revokes_statement_id
negative_vectors.comment: status=revoked MUST carry revokes_statement_id; otherwise the revocation is unanchored ⇒ schema_violation.

negative_vectors.name: revoked_without_revokes_statement_id_schema
negative_vectors.comment: Strong payload schema allOf requires revokes_statement_id when status=revoked.

negative_vectors.name: active_carrying_revokes_statement_id
negative_vectors.comment: status=active MUST NOT carry revokes_statement_id (a live endorsement is not a revocation) ⇒ schema_violation.

negative_vectors.name: legacy_organization_ref_shape
negative_vectors.comment: The pre-migration singleton shape { organization_ref } must be rejected by the strong schema (required fields missing).

negative_vectors.name: invalid_relationship_enum
negative_vectors.comment: relationship is a closed enum {owner, governance, sponsor, directory_certifier}; `admin` is not a member.

negative_vectors.name: invalid_control_scope_enum
negative_vectors.comment: control_scopes items are a closed enum; `not_a_scope` is not a member.

positive_control.name: active_organization_did_statement
positive_control.comment: Sanity control: the unmutated base statement MUST pass both the strong schema and the verifier under the no_delegation resolver.
